newsitem.title: USA: Grace chemicals in market for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Grace chemicals in market for acquisitions.

text.p: W.R. Grace's specialty chemicals and construction division will be debt free and in the market for acquisitions in the region of $200 million to $300 million, company chief executive Albert Costello said Thursday in a telephone interview.
Asked whether businesses in the U.S. would be attractive, Costello said, "probably not."
"There are some attractive businesses out there, mostly international," Costello said.
Grace Specialty Chemicals Co will have a market capitalization of $2.0 billion to $2.5 billion when it is listed.
Grace said on Thursday that it will spin off its packaging division into a company owned 63 percent by Grace shareholders and 37 by Sealed Air Corp under a tax free transaction.
